error.already: <tc:error>You are already in a party. Leave it first with <tc:accent>/party leave</tc:accent>.
invite.received: <tc:text><tc:accent>{leader}</tc:accent> invited you to their party. <click:run_command:'/party accept {leader}'><hover:show_text:'<tc:text>Join the party of <tc:accent>{leader}</tc:accent>'><tc:accent>[Accept]</tc:accent></hover></click>
error.notleader: <tc:error>Only the party leader can do that. Ask them to.
error.noparty: <tc:error>You are not in a party. Create one with <tc:accent>/party create</tc:accent>.
error.kick.self: <tc:error>Use <tc:accent>/party leave</tc:accent> to leave your own party.
list.empty: <tc:text>You are not in a party. <click:run_command:'/party create'><hover:show_text:'<tc:text>Create a new party'><tc:accent>[Create party]</tc:accent></hover></click>
